---
applyTo: "apps/web/**/*.{ts,tsx}"
---

# Frontend Rules (NLWeb / Next.js)
- Build a **single page** with an input box and a results section.
- Show **Answer**, **Why (bullets)**, **Sources**; truncate long source text with “Show more”.
- Accessibility first: use labels, roles, keyboard nav; no color-only cues.
- Strict TypeScript; avoid `any`.
- Do not ship secret keys to the browser.
